mechanism.claim: During a high-variation completed eight-hour BTC path, an extreme asymmetry between downside and upside absolute return per unit quote turnover identifies which side of the book is structurally fragile. Relay toward the fragile side for eight elapsed hours.
mechanism.side: negative sign of log(downside impact/upside impact): downside fragility maps short, upside fragility maps long
mechanism.why_distinct: Existing liquidity-impact work measures aggregate turnover efficiency and follows displacement. HVPIAR compares separately completed positive and negative bar impact and does not use block direction, aggressor flow, spread, OI, funding, or a prior control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: the asymmetry is admitted only when completed path variation is in its causal upper tail
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: a directional book-fragility asymmetry clock is absent from Gross9

features.path: 96 exact completed five-minute bars in [decision-8h,decision), plus exact prior close
features.bar_return: log(close/previous close), strict nonzero bars assigned by sign
features.side_support: at least 16 positive-return and 16 negative-return bars; zero returns excluded
features.upside_impact: sum positive returns / sum quote turnover on positive-return bars
features.downside_impact: sum absolute negative returns / sum quote turnover on negative-return bars
features.asymmetry_rank: strict-prior midrank of abs(impact_asymmetry) over at most 270 valid blocks, minimum 252, current excluded; rank>=0.80
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over same policy, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.reservation: natural nonoverlap; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not signal input; exact settlements after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

definitions.no_asymmetry_tail: fragility side and variation gate without asymmetry rank
definitions.one_block_stale_asymmetry: prior block asymmetry with current variation

source_plan.live_extension: read-only Postgres BTCUSDT 1m OHLC and quote_asset_volume through 2026-08-01
source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source and novelty pass

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no source, impact definition, rank, variation, side, clock, hold, subset, threshold, comparator, or control repair
